title: Spatial Agent Room View Phase A

dependency.requirement: Reuse one verified Agent Room normalized truth model; do not create a parallel session/work authority.

productBoundary.purpose: Project normalized Agent Work OS state into a deterministic, read-only spatial scene and render it as an alternate Agent Room view.

inputs: declared metric presentation policies when present
invariants: Equivalent canonical inputs produce equivalent normalized scene content and the same digest.
Unknown, missing and stale facts remain explicit and are never fabricated for visual completeness.
Spatial proximity never creates a delegation, ownership or causal edge.
Every attention/Town Hall item retains the exact source session/event evidence that justified it.
Replay cursor changes presentation only and never mutates canonical runtime state.
Renderer/projector failures cannot start, stop, interrupt, approve, edit or deploy agent work.
Metric-to-geometry mappings are bounded, clamped and retain policy ID, source and timestamp.
Secret-shaped values are omitted from presentation rather than exposed.
A future public scene must be produced from a separate allowlisted redaction projection, not by hiding private rendered fields.

goldenPaths.name: deterministic scene projection
goldenPaths.given: a valid synthetic Agent Room state with known machines, repositories, sessions and events
goldenPaths.then: both normalized scenes and digests are identical

goldenPaths.name: human attention queue
goldenPaths.given: a session with explicit approval, permission, waiting or error evidence
goldenPaths.then: the actor is represented in the attention/Town Hall queue with source evidence and without guessing an approver

goldenPaths.name: unknown topology
goldenPaths.given: sessions without explicit team or delegation relationships
goldenPaths.then: no relationship edge is invented; only known grouping metadata is used

goldenPaths.name: read-only replay
goldenPaths.then: display state changes while canonical runtime state remains byte-for-byte unchanged

goldenPaths.name: bounded metric geometry
goldenPaths.given: extreme, missing and stale metric inputs
goldenPaths.when: a declared presentation policy maps metrics to scene geometry
goldenPaths.then: values are clamped or marked unknown/stale and retain provenance metadata

negativePaths: malformed canonical state fails visibly and does not render fabricated actors
duplicate event identity is rejected or deterministically de-duplicated according to the projector contract
an attention item without source evidence is refused
an attempted causal path without a canonical relationship is not emitted
secret-shaped event payload content is omitted
public projection containing non-allowlisted private detail is refused
renderer exception leaves agent/session execution untouched
implementationSlice: read-only Canvas demo behind an Agent Room view switch
explicitNonGoals: copying donor assets, CSS, characters, layout or copy
agent command or approval execution from Canvas
promotionGate: Do not enter BUILDING until PR #96 Agent Room truth-model gates are green or this contract is explicitly scheduled as a bounded dependency using that same model.

tracker.reason: Collision-free canonical reconciliation required; do not guess beyond the current Library maximum during concurrent intake.
